evidence.reason: The recovery path accepts a `snapshot` phase record only with `state` null (line 1581: `record["phase"] == "snapshot" and record.get("state") is not None` => Refused), but then unconditionally derives `retained` from `record["state"]` (line 1597), which yields None for every snapshot-phase record, and raises `Refused("invalid retained prior head for unit recovery")` at 1600-1601 before `adapter.stop_and_drain`/restore. Because the record must have `state: null` in this phase, snapshot-phase intents can never be recovered when an adapter_factory is supplied, and the pending record continues to block other controller operations via `refuse_unfinished_transactions`. This is an internal dead-end in the existing recover behavior, not a request for new protection scope, and the contract records no accepted limitation for snapshot-phase recovery. The smallest compatible repair is to persist the prior render source when the snapshot-phase journal is written and use it during recovery (never falling back to the current HEAD), consistent with the fail-closed intent of the existing comment.
